hypotheses.rationale: The consistent afternoon activity with object_12 across weekdays strongly suggests a work-from-home routine. The morning activity with object_4 and object_11 on days 3-4 indicates a regular morning preparation pattern. The absence of object_12 activity on Saturday (day 5) and its different pattern on Sunday (day 6) supports the work week hypothesis. Day 7 (Monday) shows a return to weekday morning routine with object_4 at receptacle_12 at 07:00, consistent with previous weekdays.
The timing of activities could still align with a student's schedule, though the consistency across weekdays and weekend difference makes this less likely than a professional routine.
The pattern of activities doesn't strongly support a retired person's typical routine, and the consistency suggests a more structured schedule.
